## A party balloon (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "The cycle spec: the balloon's float"): a Sprite3D on one
## of the balloon sheets, bobbing on its string to `float` (animations/balloon_float.tres) on
## its own AnimationPlayer. This script is that player's one authority, the only caller of
## its play() and seek().
##   - `colour` (red, yellow or blue) picks the sheet and where in the float it starts, so
##     the three at the party don't sway in step.
##   - pop() is the bite's (camp_balloons.gd, game code): it sets `popped` and hides the
##     balloon. (The `pop` clip, cells 3-5, is Step 4's.)
## The node's offset puts its origin on the balloon's body: the body sits in the 14 x 19 px
## box at (1, 1) of each 16 x 32 px cell (assets/sprites/balloons/ATTRIBUTION.md), so its
## middle is 5.5 px above the cell's; the scene draws the cell 5.5 px lower. The sheets
## aren't edited.
## Written by Claude Code on 21 Nov 2026.

const SHEETS := {
	"red": preload("res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_red_4.png"),
	"yellow": preload("res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_yellow.png"),
	"blue": preload("res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_blue_4.png"),
}
## Seconds into the 1 s float each colour starts at: a third of the way apart, so at any
## moment no two show the same cell for long.
const FLOAT_OFFSETS := {"red": 0.0, "yellow": 1.0 / 3.0, "blue": 2.0 / 3.0}

@export_enum("red", "yellow", "blue") var colour := "red"
## True once he's bitten it.
var popped := false

@onready var _anim: AnimationPlayer = $AnimationPlayer


func _ready() -> void:
	texture = SHEETS[colour]
	_anim.play("float")
	_anim.seek(FLOAT_OFFSETS[colour], true)


## Bitten: gone. Once only.
func pop() -> void:
	if popped:
		return
	popped = true
	hide()

extends SceneTree
## Assignment 7, Step 5 (Step 4 of its plan): the read-back of the balloon's `pop` (CHANGE-BRIEF.md,
## revision of 21 Nov 2026, "The extras' timings and places"), a light one beside
## tests/test_balloon_float.gd. It loads props/party_balloon.tscn and reads back:
##   - every track in every clip resolves (the course's check, as in test_balloon_float.gd);
##   - `pop` beside `float` in the scene's library;
##   - one value track on the Sprite3D's frame, UPDATE_DISCRETE;
##   - keys: cells 3, 4, 5 at 0, 2/24 and 4/24 s, within half a frame (1/48 s), never ==; every
##     cell inside the sheet (below hframes * vframes);
##   - length 6/24 s (within half a frame), step 1/24 s exactly, LOOP_NONE;
##   - a one-shot that ends on its own pose: the last cell differs from the first.
## A headless run draws nothing: this reads the clip's structure, not how the pop looks.
## Run it from the project folder:
##   bash scripts/run-test.sh test_balloon_pop.gd 60
## It prints PASS or FAIL per check and a count, and quits with exit code 1 if any check fails.
## Written by Claude Code on 21 Nov 2026.

const FloatTest := preload("res://tests/test_balloon_float.gd")
const SCENE := "res://props/party_balloon.tscn"
const FPS := 24.0
const HALF_FRAME := 1.0 / 48.0
const CELLS: Array[int] = [3, 4, 5]
const TIMES: Array[float] = [0.0, 2.0 / 24.0, 4.0 / 24.0]
const LENGTH := 6.0 / 24.0

var _passed := 0
var _failed := 0


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run()
	print("%d passed, %d failed" % [_passed, _failed])
	quit(1 if _failed > 0 else 0)


func _check(ok: bool, what: String, detail: String = "") -> void:
	if ok:
		_passed += 1
		print("PASS %s" % what)
	else:
		_failed += 1
		print("FAIL %s%s" % [what, (": " + detail) if detail != "" else ""])


func _near(a: float, b: float) -> bool:
	return absf(a - b) <= HALF_FRAME


func _run() -> void:
	var balloon := (load(SCENE) as PackedScene).instantiate() as Sprite3D
	root.add_child(balloon)
	var player := balloon.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
	var problems := FloatTest.track_problems(player)
	_check(problems.is_empty(), "every track in every clip resolves to a real node and property or bone", "; ".join(problems))
	_check(player.has_animation("pop") and player.has_animation("float"), "`pop` is in the scene's library beside `float`",
		str(player.get_animation_list()))
	if not player.has_animation("pop"):
		return
	var clip := player.get_animation("pop")
	_check(_near(clip.length, LENGTH), "the length is 6/24 s (within 1/48 s)", "%.10f" % clip.length)
	_check(is_equal_approx(clip.step, 1.0 / FPS), "step is 1/24 s", "%.10f" % clip.step)
	_check(clip.loop_mode == Animation.LOOP_NONE, "loop_mode is Animation.LOOP_NONE", str(clip.loop_mode))
	_check(clip.get_track_count() == 1, "one track", str(clip.get_track_count()))
	if clip.get_track_count() != 1:
		return
	var is_value := clip.track_get_type(0) == Animation.TYPE_VALUE
	_check(is_value, "track 0 is a value track (TYPE_VALUE)", str(clip.track_get_type(0)))
	var path := clip.track_get_path(0)
	var target := player.get_node(player.root_node).get_node_or_null(NodePath(path.get_concatenated_names()))
	_check(target == balloon and path.get_subname_count() == 1 and path.get_subname(0) == "frame", "track 0 is on the Sprite3D's frame", str(path))
	if not is_value:
		return
	_check(clip.value_track_get_update_mode(0) == Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE, "track 0 uses discrete updates (UPDATE_DISCRETE)",
		str(clip.value_track_get_update_mode(0)))
	var cells: Array = []
	var times: Array = []
	for k in clip.track_get_key_count(0):
		cells.append(clip.track_get_key_value(0, k))
		times.append(clip.track_get_key_time(0, k))
	print("  keys: cells %s at %s s" % [cells, times])
	var inside := cells.all(func(c) -> bool: return typeof(c) == TYPE_INT and c >= 0 and c < balloon.hframes * balloon.vframes)
	_check(inside, "every frame key is a cell inside the sheet (0 to %d)" % (balloon.hframes * balloon.vframes - 1), str(cells))
	_check(cells.size() == 3 and cells == CELLS, "the key values are 3, 4, 5", str(cells))
	var times_ok := times.size() == 3
	for k in mini(times.size(), 3):
		times_ok = times_ok and _near(times[k], TIMES[k])
	_check(times_ok, "the key times are 0, 2/24, 4/24 s (within 1/48 s)", str(times))
	_check(cells.size() > 1 and cells[-1] != cells[0], "a one-shot: it ends on its own cell, not its first", str(cells))

extends SceneTree
## Assignment 7, Step 5 (Step 3 of its plan): Pop the balloons (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Boundaries:
## named changes"; "The cycle spec: the balloon's float" for the balloons; "The phase table:
## the jump" for the bite; "The evidence split": the task row).
##
## In the real level (main.tscn at the developer menu's "free" point, the camp's tasks
## revealed, as tests/jump_pins.gd runs it), with the campers blind to him (campsite.gd
## `cones_on` off, as bear_bag_test.gd and tent_test.gd do) so none of them spots him and
## gives chase, but hearing as ever; driven through the game loop with real key presses
## (Input.parse_input_event), read each physics tick after the bite check. It checks:
##   - the balloons: three, red, yellow and blue, each on its sheet's 3 x 2 grid, 0.3 m across,
##     its middle 0.7 m up, clear of the table's top, with no collision; each AnimationPlayer
##     playing `float` (current_animation) while it's up, not in step with the others;
##   - one authority: in props/party_balloon.gd every play() and seek() is on its own
##     AnimationPlayer; camp_balloons.gd calls neither; no other script uses the balloon;
##   - the task: on the list under Rock the party, with its hint;
##   - three jumps (F held), one under each balloon: each pops it within the bite (ticks 5-14
##     after F is seen), each pop heard by every camper within 8 m of it (HEAR_CHITTER: they
##     turn to it, camp_person.gd `_noise_at`) and by none further; the task not ticked after
##     one or two, ticked on the third;
##   - with balloons the test adds (from the same scene, given to camp_balloons.gd): one at
##     his mouth through the crouch (ticks 0-4) isn't popped, and pops on tick 5; two at his
##     mouth, one jump pops one; one in reach only as he comes down after a running jump
##     (after tick 14) isn't popped.
## A headless run draws nothing: this checks the game's state, not how the balloons or the
## jump look. The source scan can't see an indirect call.
## Run it from the project folder:
##   bash scripts/run-test.sh test_balloon_task.gd 60
## It prints PASS or FAIL per check and quits with exit code 1 if any check fails.
## Written by Claude Code on 21 Nov 2026.

signal ticked

const DevMenu := preload("res://scripts/dev_menu.gd")
const BalloonScene := preload("res://props/party_balloon.tscn")
const CampsiteScript := preload("res://scripts/campsite.gd")
## Well out of the camp, where none of them can see him (scripts/cones_test.gd, _send_away).
const QUIET := Vector3(20.0, 0.02, 6.5)
const HEAR := 8.0
const REACH := 0.25
const COLOURS := ["red", "yellow", "blue"]
const SHEETS := {
	"red": "res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_red_4.png",
	"yellow": "res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_yellow.png",
	"blue": "res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_blue_4.png",
}
## The table's top, from its middle (campsite.gd _table_legs: 1.28 x 0.83 m).
const TABLE_HALF := Vector2(0.64, 0.415)

var level: Node
var camp: Node
var player: CharacterBody3D
var balloons_node: Node3D

var _tick := 0
var _checks := 0
var _failed := 0
## Ticks since the current jump's press was seen (0 on that tick), -1 when not jumping.
var _jt := -1
var _was_jumping := false
## Every pop: {balloon, tick, jt, heard: [[name, distance, heard]], visible (on the pop's
## tick), clip (current_animation on it)}.
var _pops: Array[Dictionary] = []
var _seen_popped := {}
## For each popped balloon, after its pop tick: {cells: the frames it showed while still
## visible, starts: how often `pop` began (from its start), hidden: the tick it was first
## hidden, last: `pop`'s position last tick}.
var _after := {}


func _initialize() -> void:
	DevMenu._next = "free"
	level = (load("res://main.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate()
	root.add_child(level)
	current_scene = level
	var probe := Probe.new()
	probe.test = self
	# After the player's tick (0) and the bite check's (camp_balloons.gd, 1).
	probe.process_physics_priority = 1000
	root.add_child(probe)
	print("Pop the balloons: the real level at the developer menu's \"free\" point, %d physics ticks a second"
		% Engine.physics_ticks_per_second)
	_run()


class Probe extends Node:
	var test: Object

	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
		test.call("step")


func step() -> void:
	_tick += 1
	if player == null:
		player = level.get("player")
		camp = level.get("campsite")
		balloons_node = camp.get("balloons")
	var jumping: bool = player.get("jumping")
	if jumping and not _was_jumping:
		_jt = 0
	elif jumping:
		_jt += 1
	elif not jumping:
		_jt = -1
	_was_jumping = jumping
	for b: Sprite3D in balloons_node.get("balloons"):
		if b.get("popped") and not _seen_popped.has(b):
			_seen_popped[b] = true
			var heard: Array = []
			for person: Node3D in camp.get("people"):
				var d := Vector2(person.global_position.x - b.global_position.x, person.global_position.z - b.global_position.z).length()
				var at: Vector3 = person.get("_noise_at")
				heard.append([person.name, d, at.distance_to(b.global_position) < 0.01])
			_pops.append({"balloon": b, "tick": _tick, "jt": _jt, "heard": heard})
	ticked.emit()


func _check(what: String, ok: bool, got: Variant = "") -> void:
	_checks += 1
	if not ok:
		_failed += 1
	print("%s  %s  (got %s)" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, str(got)])


func _key(keycode: int, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = keycode as Key
	ev.physical_keycode = keycode as Key
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)


func _wait(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await ticked


func _until(cond: Callable, most: int) -> bool:
	for i in most:
		if cond.call():
			return true
		await ticked
	return cond.call()


func _real() -> Array[Sprite3D]:
	var out: Array[Sprite3D] = []
	out.assign(balloons_node.get("balloons").slice(0, 3))
	return out


## Holds F until he's down and the landing's over, then lets go.
func _jump() -> void:
	_key(KEY_F, true)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt >= 0, 20)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt < 0, 120)
	_key(KEY_F, false)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return not bool(player.get("model").get("jumping")), 30)
	await _wait(5)


## Puts him on the ground with his mouth (player.gd mouth_point()) under `at`.
func _under(at: Vector3) -> void:
	var off: Vector3 = player.call("mouth_point") - player.global_position
	player.call("place", Vector3(at.x - off.x, 0.02, at.z - off.z))
	await _wait(20)


func _run() -> void:
	await ticked
	camp.set("cones_on", false)
	await _wait(30)
	_structure()
	await _task()
	await _edges()
	print("RESULT: %s (%d checks, %d failed)" % ["FAILED" if _failed > 0 else "all checks passed", _checks, _failed])
	quit(1 if _failed > 0 else 0)


# --- The balloons, the task, one authority -------------------------------------------

func _structure() -> void:
	var real := _real()
	_check("three balloons, red, yellow and blue", real.size() == 3 and real.map(func(b) -> String: return b.get("colour")) == COLOURS,
		real.map(func(b) -> String: return b.get("colour")))
	var table: Array = CampsiteScript.TABLE
	var camp_at: Vector3 = (camp as Node3D).global_position
	var table_mid: Vector3 = Vector3(table[0].x, 0.0, table[0].y) + camp_at
	for b in real:
		var c: String = b.get("colour")
		var sheet := b.texture.resource_path if b.texture else ""
		_check("%s: its own sheet, sliced 3 x 2" % c, sheet == SHEETS[c] and b.hframes == 3 and b.vframes == 2,
			"%s %d x %d" % [sheet, b.hframes, b.vframes])
		_check("%s: 0.3 m across (its body's 14 px at pixel_size)" % c, absf(b.pixel_size * 14.0 - 0.3) < 0.001, b.pixel_size * 14.0)
		var up: float = b.global_position.y - camp_at.y
		_check("%s: its middle 0.7 m up (the node's offset puts its origin on the body's middle)" % c,
			absf(up - 0.7) < 0.01 and b.offset == Vector2(0, -5.5), "%.3f m, offset %s" % [up, b.offset])
		var rel: Vector3 = b.global_position - table_mid
		_check("%s: clear of the table's top" % c, absf(rel.x) > TABLE_HALF.x or absf(rel.z) > TABLE_HALF.y,
			"%.2f, %.2f from its middle" % [rel.x, rel.z])
		var bodies := b.find_children("*", "CollisionObject3D", true, false).size() + b.find_children("*", "CollisionShape3D", true, false).size()
		_check("%s: no collision" % c, bodies == 0, bodies)
		var anim := b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
		_check("%s: its AnimationPlayer plays `float` while it's up" % c, anim.current_animation == "float", anim.current_animation)
	var at := real.map(func(b) -> float: return (b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer).current_animation_position)
	var apart := absf(at[0] - at[1]) > 0.1 and absf(at[1] - at[2]) > 0.1 and absf(at[0] - at[2]) > 0.1
	_check("not in step: each starts its float at its own offset (positions %s s)" % str(at.map(func(p) -> String: return "%.3f" % p)), apart, at)

	var task: Dictionary = {}
	for t: Dictionary in camp.get("tasks").list:
		if t.id == "balloons":
			task = t
	_check("the task: Pop the balloons, under Rock the party, \"Jump and bite all three.\"",
		task.get("text") == "Pop the balloons" and task.get("parent") == "party" and task.get("hint") == "Jump and bite all three.", task)

	var files := {}
	for dir: String in ["res://scripts", "res://props"]:
		for f: String in DirAccess.get_files_at(dir):
			if f.ends_with(".gd"):
				files[dir + "/" + f] = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(dir + "/" + f)
	var calls := RegEx.create_from_string("([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\\.(play|seek)\\(")
	var off: Array = []
	var on_anim := 0
	for m in calls.search_all(files.get("res://props/party_balloon.gd", "")):
		if m.get_string(1) == "_anim":
			on_anim += 1
		else:
			off.append(m.get_string(0))
	_check("party_balloon.gd: every play() and seek() is on its own AnimationPlayer (%d)" % on_anim, off.is_empty() and on_anim == 2, off)
	var game: String = files.get("res://scripts/camp_balloons.gd", "")
	_check("camp_balloons.gd calls no play() or seek(), and has no AnimationPlayer",
		calls.search(game) == null and not game.contains("AnimationPlayer"), "")
	var users: Array = []
	for path: String in files:
		if files[path].contains("party_balloon") and path.get_file() not in ["camp_balloons.gd", "party_balloon.gd"]:
			users.append(path)
	_check("no other game script uses the balloon", users.is_empty(), users)


func _task() -> void:
	var tasks = camp.get("tasks")
	var real := _real()
	for i in 3:
		var b := real[i]
		var c: String = b.get("colour")
		await _under(b.global_position)
		var before := _pops.size()
		await _jump()
		var mine := _pops.slice(before)
		_check("%s: a jump under it (F held) pops it" % c, mine.size() == 1 and mine[0].balloon == b and b.get("popped") and not b.visible,
			"%d pops, popped %s, visible %s" % [mine.size(), b.get("popped"), b.visible])
		if mine.size() == 1:
			var jt: int = mine[0].jt
			_check("%s: popped within the bite, ticks 5-14 after F is seen (on tick %d)" % [c, jt], jt >= 5 and jt <= 14, jt)
			var wrong: Array = []
			for h: Array in mine[0].heard:
				if (h[1] <= HEAR) != h[2]:
					wrong.append("%s at %.2f m: heard %s" % h)
			_check("%s: heard by every camper within 8 m and no one further (%s)" % [c,
				", ".join(mine[0].heard.map(func(h: Array) -> String: return "%s %.1f m %s" % [h[0], h[1], "heard" if h[2] else "not"]))],
				wrong.is_empty(), wrong)
		for other in real:
			if not other.get("popped"):
				var a := other.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
				_check("%s still up: `float` playing" % other.get("colour"), a.current_animation == "float", a.current_animation)
		var want := i == 2
		_check("after %d popped: the task %s" % [i + 1, "ticked" if want else "not ticked yet"], tasks.is_done("balloons") == want,
			tasks.is_done("balloons"))
	var inside := 0
	var outside := 0
	for p: Dictionary in _pops:
		for h: Array in p.heard:
			if h[1] <= HEAR:
				inside += 1
			else:
				outside += 1
	_check("the hearing was tried both ways: campers within 8 m of a pop (%d) and further (%d)" % [inside, outside],
		inside > 0 and outside > 0, "%d, %d" % [inside, outside])


# --- The bite's edges, with balloons the test adds ----------------------------------

func _extra() -> Sprite3D:
	var b := BalloonScene.instantiate() as Sprite3D
	balloons_node.add_child(b)
	balloons_node.get("balloons").append(b)
	return b


func _edges() -> void:
	# At his mouth through the crouch: not popped on ticks 0-4, popped on tick 5.
	player.call("place", QUIET)

extends SceneTree
## Assignment 7, Step 5 (Step 3 of its plan): Pop the balloons (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Boundaries:
## named changes"; "The cycle spec: the balloon's float" for the balloons; "The phase table:
## the jump" for the bite; "The evidence split": the task row).
##
## In the real level (main.tscn at the developer menu's "free" point, the camp's tasks
## revealed, as tests/jump_pins.gd runs it), with the campers blind to him (campsite.gd
## `cones_on` off, as bear_bag_test.gd and tent_test.gd do) so none of them spots him and
## gives chase, but hearing as ever; driven through the game loop with real key presses
## (Input.parse_input_event), read each physics tick after the bite check. It checks:
##   - the balloons: three, red, yellow and blue, each on its sheet's 3 x 2 grid, 0.3 m across,
##     its middle 0.7 m up, clear of the table's top, with no collision; each AnimationPlayer
##     playing `float` (current_animation) while it's up, not in step with the others;
##   - one authority: in props/party_balloon.gd every play() and seek() is on its own
##     AnimationPlayer; camp_balloons.gd calls neither; no other script uses the balloon;
##   - the task: on the list under Rock the party, with its hint;
##   - three jumps (F held), one under each balloon: each pops it within the bite (ticks 5-14
##     after F is seen), each pop heard by every camper within 8 m of it (HEAR_CHITTER: they
##     turn to it, camp_person.gd `_noise_at`) and by none further; the task not ticked after
##     one or two, ticked on the third;
##   - with balloons the test adds (from the same scene, given to camp_balloons.gd): one at
##     his mouth through the crouch (ticks 0-4) isn't popped, and pops on tick 5; two at his
##     mouth, one jump pops one; one in reach only as he comes down after a running jump
##     (after tick 14) isn't popped.
## A headless run draws nothing: this checks the game's state, not how the balloons or the
## jump look. The source scan can't see an indirect call.
## Run it from the project folder:
##   bash scripts/run-test.sh test_balloon_task.gd 60
## It prints PASS or FAIL per check and quits with exit code 1 if any check fails.
## Written by Claude Code on 21 Nov 2026.

signal ticked

const DevMenu := preload("res://scripts/dev_menu.gd")
const BalloonScene := preload("res://props/party_balloon.tscn")
const CampsiteScript := preload("res://scripts/campsite.gd")
## Well out of the camp, where none of them can see him (scripts/cones_test.gd, _send_away).
const QUIET := Vector3(20.0, 0.02, 6.5)
const HEAR := 8.0
const REACH := 0.25
const COLOURS := ["red", "yellow", "blue"]
const SHEETS := {
	"red": "res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_red_4.png",
	"yellow": "res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_yellow.png",
	"blue": "res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_blue_4.png",
}
## The table's top, from its middle (campsite.gd _table_legs: 1.28 x 0.83 m).
const TABLE_HALF := Vector2(0.64, 0.415)

var level: Node
var camp: Node
var player: CharacterBody3D
var balloons_node: Node3D

var _tick := 0
var _checks := 0
var _failed := 0
## Ticks since the current jump's press was seen (0 on that tick), -1 when not jumping.
var _jt := -1
var _was_jumping := false
## Every pop: {balloon, tick, jt, heard: [[name, distance, heard]], visible (on the pop's
## tick), clip (current_animation on it)}.
var _pops: Array[Dictionary] = []
var _seen_popped := {}
## For each popped balloon, after its pop tick: {cells: the frames it showed while still
## visible, starts: how often `pop` began (from its start), hidden: the tick it was first
## hidden, last: `pop`'s position last tick}.
var _after := {}


func _initialize() -> void:
	DevMenu._next = "free"
	level = (load("res://main.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate()
	root.add_child(level)
	current_scene = level
	var probe := Probe.new()
	probe.test = self
	# After the player's tick (0) and the bite check's (camp_balloons.gd, 1).
	probe.process_physics_priority = 1000
	root.add_child(probe)
	print("Pop the balloons: the real level at the developer menu's \"free\" point, %d physics ticks a second"
		% Engine.physics_ticks_per_second)
	_run()


class Probe extends Node:
	var test: Object

	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
		test.call("step")


func step() -> void:
	_tick += 1
	if player == null:
		player = level.get("player")
		camp = level.get("campsite")
		balloons_node = camp.get("balloons")
	var jumping: bool = player.get("jumping")
	if jumping and not _was_jumping:
		_jt = 0
	elif jumping:
		_jt += 1
	elif not jumping:
		_jt = -1
	_was_jumping = jumping
	for b: Sprite3D in balloons_node.get("balloons"):
		var anim := b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
		if b.get("popped") and not _seen_popped.has(b):
			_seen_popped[b] = true
			var heard: Array = []
			for person: Node3D in camp.get("people"):
				var d := Vector2(person.global_position.x - b.global_position.x, person.global_position.z - b.global_position.z).length()
				var at: Vector3 = person.get("_noise_at")
				heard.append([person.name, d, at.distance_to(b.global_position) < 0.01])
			_pops.append({"balloon": b, "tick": _tick, "jt": _jt, "heard": heard, "visible": b.visible,
				"clip": String(anim.current_animation)})
			_after[b] = {"cells": [], "starts": 0, "hidden": -1, "last": INF, "pop_tick": _tick}
		elif _after.has(b):
			var a: Dictionary = _after[b]
			if b.visible:
				if not b.frame in a.cells:
					a.cells.append(b.frame)
				# `pop` began again from its start: its position went back.
				if anim.assigned_animation == "pop" and anim.current_animation_position < a.last - 0.001:
					a.starts += 1
				a.last = anim.current_animation_position
			elif a.hidden < 0:
				a.hidden = _tick
	ticked.emit()


func _check(what: String, ok: bool, got: Variant = "") -> void:
	_checks += 1
	if not ok:
		_failed += 1
	print("%s  %s  (got %s)" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, str(got)])


func _key(keycode: int, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = keycode as Key
	ev.physical_keycode = keycode as Key
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)


func _wait(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await ticked


func _until(cond: Callable, most: int) -> bool:
	for i in most:
		if cond.call():
			return true
		await ticked
	return cond.call()


func _real() -> Array[Sprite3D]:
	var out: Array[Sprite3D] = []
	out.assign(balloons_node.get("balloons").slice(0, 3))
	return out


## Holds F until he's down and the landing's over, then lets go.
func _jump() -> void:
	_key(KEY_F, true)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt >= 0, 20)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt < 0, 120)
	_key(KEY_F, false)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return not bool(player.get("model").get("jumping")), 30)
	await _wait(5)


## Puts him on the ground with his mouth (player.gd mouth_point()) under `at`.
func _under(at: Vector3) -> void:
	var off: Vector3 = player.call("mouth_point") - player.global_position
	player.call("place", Vector3(at.x - off.x, 0.02, at.z - off.z))
	await _wait(20)


func _run() -> void:
	await ticked
	camp.set("cones_on", false)
	await _wait(30)
	_structure()
	await _task()
	await _edges()
	print("RESULT: %s (%d checks, %d failed)" % ["FAILED" if _failed > 0 else "all checks passed", _checks, _failed])
	quit(1 if _failed > 0 else 0)


# --- The balloons, the task, one authority -------------------------------------------

func _structure() -> void:
	var real := _real()
	_check("three balloons, red, yellow and blue", real.size() == 3 and real.map(func(b) -> String: return b.get("colour")) == COLOURS,
		real.map(func(b) -> String: return b.get("colour")))
	var table: Array = CampsiteScript.TABLE
	var camp_at: Vector3 = (camp as Node3D).global_position
	var table_mid: Vector3 = Vector3(table[0].x, 0.0, table[0].y) + camp_at
	for b in real:
		var c: String = b.get("colour")
		var sheet := b.texture.resource_path if b.texture else ""
		_check("%s: its own sheet, sliced 3 x 2" % c, sheet == SHEETS[c] and b.hframes == 3 and b.vframes == 2,
			"%s %d x %d" % [sheet, b.hframes, b.vframes])
		_check("%s: 0.3 m across (its body's 14 px at pixel_size)" % c, absf(b.pixel_size * 14.0 - 0.3) < 0.001, b.pixel_size * 14.0)
		var up: float = b.global_position.y - camp_at.y
		_check("%s: its middle 0.7 m up (the node's offset puts its origin on the body's middle)" % c,
			absf(up - 0.7) < 0.01 and b.offset == Vector2(0, -5.5), "%.3f m, offset %s" % [up, b.offset])
		var rel: Vector3 = b.global_position - table_mid
		_check("%s: clear of the table's top" % c, absf(rel.x) > TABLE_HALF.x or absf(rel.z) > TABLE_HALF.y,
			"%.2f, %.2f from its middle" % [rel.x, rel.z])
		var bodies := b.find_children("*", "CollisionObject3D", true, false).size() + b.find_children("*", "CollisionShape3D", true, false).size()
		_check("%s: no collision" % c, bodies == 0, bodies)
		var anim := b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
		_check("%s: its AnimationPlayer plays `float` while it's up" % c, anim.current_animation == "float", anim.current_animation)
	var at := real.map(func(b) -> float: return (b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer).current_animation_position)
	var apart := absf(at[0] - at[1]) > 0.1 and absf(at[1] - at[2]) > 0.1 and absf(at[0] - at[2]) > 0.1
	_check("not in step: each starts its float at its own offset (positions %s s)" % str(at.map(func(p) -> String: return "%.3f" % p)), apart, at)

	var task: Dictionary = {}
	for t: Dictionary in camp.get("tasks").list:
		if t.id == "balloons":
			task = t
	_check("the task: Pop the balloons, under Rock the party, \"Jump and bite all three.\"",
		task.get("text") == "Pop the balloons" and task.get("parent") == "party" and task.get("hint") == "Jump and bite all three.", task)

	var files := {}
	for dir: String in ["res://scripts", "res://props"]:
		for f: String in DirAccess.get_files_at(dir):
			if f.ends_with(".gd"):
				files[dir + "/" + f] = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(dir + "/" + f)
	var calls := RegEx.create_from_string("([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\\.(play|seek)\\(")
	var off: Array = []
	var on_anim := 0
	for m in calls.search_all(files.get("res://props/party_balloon.gd", "")):
		if m.get_string(1) == "_anim":
			on_anim += 1
		else:
			off.append(m.get_string(0))
	_check("party_balloon.gd: every play() and seek() is on its own AnimationPlayer (%d)" % on_anim, off.is_empty() and on_anim == 2, off)
	var game: String = files.get("res://scripts/camp_balloons.gd", "")
	_check("camp_balloons.gd calls no play() or seek(), and has no AnimationPlayer",
		calls.search(game) == null and not game.contains("AnimationPlayer"), "")
	var users: Array = []
	for path: String in files:
		if files[path].contains("party_balloon") and path.get_file() not in ["camp_balloons.gd", "party_balloon.gd"]:
			users.append(path)
	_check("no other game script uses the balloon", users.is_empty(), users)


func _task() -> void:
	var tasks = camp.get("tasks")
	var real := _real()
	for i in 3:
		var b := real[i]
		var c: String = b.get("colour")
		await _under(b.global_position)
		var before := _pops.size()
		await _jump()
		var mine := _pops.slice(before)
		_check("%s: a jump under it (F held) pops it" % c, mine.size() == 1 and mine[0].balloon == b and b.get("popped") and not b.visible,
			"%d pops, popped %s, visible %s" % [mine.size(), b.get("popped"), b.visible])
		if mine.size() == 1:
			var jt: int = mine[0].jt
			_check("%s: popped within the bite, ticks 5-14 after F is seen (on tick %d)" % [c, jt], jt >= 5 and jt <= 14, jt)
			# The pop clip (Step 4): `pop` starts on the bite's tick, the balloon still showing;
			# it plays once through cells 3, 4, 5, and the balloon is hidden when it ends.
			var a: Dictionary = _after[b]
			_check("%s: on the bite's tick, `pop` starts and the balloon is still showing" % c,
				mine[0].clip == "pop" and mine[0].visible, "%s, visible %s" % [mine[0].clip, mine[0].visible])
			var cells: Array = a.cells.duplicate()
			cells.sort()
			_check("%s: `pop` plays once (started %d time(s)), showing cells %s" % [c, a.starts, cells],
				a.starts == 1 and cells == [3, 4, 5], "%d, %s" % [a.starts, cells])
			var after: int = a.hidden - a.pop_tick
			_check("%s: hidden once `pop` has played, %d ticks after the bite (its 6/24 s is 15)" % [c, after],
				after >= 15 and after <= 17, after)
			var wrong: Array = []
			for h: Array in mine[0].heard:
				if (h[1] <= HEAR) != h[2]:
					wrong.append("%s at %.2f m: heard %s" % h)
			_check("%s: heard by every camper within 8 m and no one further (%s)" % [c,
				", ".join(mine[0].heard.map(func(h: Array) -> String: return "%s %.1f m %s" % [h[0], h[1], "heard" if h[2] else "not"]))],
				wrong.is_empty(), wrong)
		for other in real:

func _extra() -> Sprite3D:

	player.call("place", QUIET)
	await _wait(40)
	var e1 := _extra()
	e1.global_position = player.call("mouth_point")
	await _wait(20)
	_check("a balloon at his mouth as he stands: not popped (no jump, no bite)", not e1.get("popped"), e1.get("popped"))

		if popped_on < 0 and e1.get("popped"):

	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt < 0, 120)
	_key(KEY_F, false)
	_check("in reach through the crouch, ticks 0-4, and not popped (%s)" % ", ".join(in_crouch.map(func(r: Array) -> String: return "%d: %.3f m" % [r[0], r[1]])),

	await _wait(20)

	await _wait(40)
	var side: Vector3 = player.global_basis.x * 0.08
	var e2 := _extra()
	var e3 := _extra()

	var e4 := _extra()
	e4.global_position = Vector3(0, -100, 0)
	_key(KEY_W, true)
	_key(KEY_SHIFT, true)
	await _wait(70)
	var ground := player.global_position.y
	_key(KEY_F, true)

		await ticked

		if player.call("bite_open") and d <= REACH:
			open_near += 1
		elif d <= REACH:

		if _tick > 100000:

	_key(KEY_F, false)
	_key(KEY_W, false)
	_key(KEY_SHIFT, false)
	_check("a running jump: the balloon out of reach on every tick of the bite", open_near == 0, open_near)
	_check("then in reach as he comes down and lands, after tick 14 (on %d ticks), and not popped" % closed_near.size(),

##     tick (Step 4); each pop heard by every camper within 8 m of it (HEAR_CHITTER: they

## Written by Claude Code on 21 Nov 2026.

## Well out of the camp, where none of them can see him (scripts/cones_test.gd, _send_away).

const REACH := 0.25

	"red": "res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_red_4.png",

}

var camp: Node
var player: CharacterBody3D
var balloons_node: Node3D

var _after := {}


func _initialize() -> void:

		% Engine.physics_ticks_per_second)
	_run()


class Probe extends Node:
	var test: Object

	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
		test.call("step")


func step() -> void:
	_tick += 1
	if player == null:
		player = level.get("player")
		camp = level.get("campsite")
		balloons_node = camp.get("balloons")
	var jumping: bool = player.get("jumping")
	if jumping and not _was_jumping:
		_jt = 0
	elif jumping:
		_jt += 1
	elif not jumping:
		_jt = -1
	_was_jumping = jumping
	for b: Sprite3D in balloons_node.get("balloons"):
		var anim := b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
		if b.get("popped") and not _seen_popped.has(b):
			_seen_popped[b] = true
			var heard: Array = []
			for person: Node3D in camp.get("people"):
				var d := Vector2(person.global_position.x - b.global_position.x, person.global_position.z - b.global_position.z).length()
				var at: Vector3 = person.get("_noise_at")
				heard.append([person.name, d, at.distance_to(b.global_position) < 0.01])
			_pops.append({"balloon": b, "tick": _tick, "jt": _jt, "heard": heard, "visible": b.visible,
				"clip": String(anim.current_animation)})
			_after[b] = {"cells": [], "starts": 0, "hidden": -1, "last": INF, "pop_tick": _tick}
		elif _after.has(b):
			var a: Dictionary = _after[b]
			if b.visible:
				if not b.frame in a.cells:
					a.cells.append(b.frame)
				# `pop` began again from its start: its position went back.
				if anim.assigned_animation == "pop" and anim.current_animation_position < a.last - 0.001:
					a.starts += 1
				a.last = anim.current_animation_position
			elif a.hidden < 0:
				a.hidden = _tick
	ticked.emit()


func _check(what: String, ok: bool, got: Variant = "") -> void:
	_checks += 1
	if not ok:
		_failed += 1
	print("%s  %s  (got %s)" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, str(got)])


func _key(keycode: int, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = keycode as Key
	ev.physical_keycode = keycode as Key
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)


func _wait(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await ticked


func _until(cond: Callable, most: int) -> bool:
	for i in most:
		if cond.call():
			return true
		await ticked
	return cond.call()


func _real() -> Array[Sprite3D]:
	var out: Array[Sprite3D] = []
	out.assign(balloons_node.get("balloons").slice(0, 3))
	return out


## Holds F until he's down and the landing's over, then lets go.
func _jump() -> void:
	_key(KEY_F, true)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt >= 0, 20)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt < 0, 120)
	_key(KEY_F, false)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return not bool(player.get("model").get("jumping")), 30)
	await _wait(5)


## Puts him on the ground with his mouth (player.gd mouth_point()) under `at`.
func _under(at: Vector3) -> void:
	var off: Vector3 = player.call("mouth_point") - player.global_position
	player.call("place", Vector3(at.x - off.x, 0.02, at.z - off.z))
	await _wait(20)


func _run() -> void:
	await ticked
	camp.set("cones_on", false)
	await _wait(30)
	_structure()
	await _task()
	await _edges()
	print("RESULT: %s (%d checks, %d failed)" % ["FAILED" if _failed > 0 else "all checks passed", _checks, _failed])
	quit(1 if _failed > 0 else 0)


# --- The balloons, the task, one authority -------------------------------------------

func _structure() -> void:
	var real := _real()
	_check("three balloons, red, yellow and blue", real.size() == 3 and real.map(func(b) -> String: return b.get("colour")) == COLOURS,
		real.map(func(b) -> String: return b.get("colour")))
	var table: Array = CampsiteScript.TABLE
	var camp_at: Vector3 = (camp as Node3D).global_position
	var table_mid: Vector3 = Vector3(table[0].x, 0.0, table[0].y) + camp_at
	for b in real:
		var c: String = b.get("colour")
		var sheet := b.texture.resource_path if b.texture else ""
		_check("%s: its own sheet, sliced 3 x 2" % c, sheet == SHEETS[c] and b.hframes == 3 and b.vframes == 2,
			"%s %d x %d" % [sheet, b.hframes, b.vframes])
		_check("%s: 0.3 m across (its body's 14 px at pixel_size)" % c, absf(b.pixel_size * 14.0 - 0.3) < 0.001, b.pixel_size * 14.0)
		var up: float = b.global_position.y - camp_at.y
		_check("%s: its middle 0.7 m up (the node's offset puts its origin on the body's middle)" % c,
			absf(up - 0.7) < 0.01 and b.offset == Vector2(0, -5.5), "%.3f m, offset %s" % [up, b.offset])
		var rel: Vector3 = b.global_position - table_mid
		_check("%s: clear of the table's top" % c, absf(rel.x) > TABLE_HALF.x or absf(rel.z) > TABLE_HALF.y,
			"%.2f, %.2f from its middle" % [rel.x, rel.z])
		var bodies := b.find_children("*", "CollisionObject3D", true, false).size() + b.find_children("*", "CollisionShape3D", true, false).size()
		_check("%s: no collision" % c, bodies == 0, bodies)
		var anim := b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
		_check("%s: its AnimationPlayer plays `float` while it's up" % c, anim.current_animation == "float", anim.current_animation)
	var at := real.map(func(b) -> float: return (b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer).current_animation_position)
	var apart := absf(at[0] - at[1]) > 0.1 and absf(at[1] - at[2]) > 0.1 and absf(at[0] - at[2]) > 0.1
	_check("not in step: each starts its float at its own offset (positions %s s)" % str(at.map(func(p) -> String: return "%.3f" % p)), apart, at)

	var task: Dictionary = {}
	for t: Dictionary in camp.get("tasks").list:
		if t.id == "balloons":
			task = t
	_check("the task: Pop the balloons, under Rock the party, \"Jump and bite all three.\"",
		task.get("text") == "Pop the balloons" and task.get("parent") == "party" and task.get("hint") == "Jump and bite all three.", task)

	var files := {}
	for dir: String in ["res://scripts", "res://props"]:
		for f: String in DirAccess.get_files_at(dir):
			if f.ends_with(".gd"):
				files[dir + "/" + f] = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(dir + "/" + f)
	var calls := RegEx.create_from_string("([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\\.(play|seek)\\(")
	var off: Array = []
	var on_anim := 0
	for m in calls.search_all(files.get("res://props/party_balloon.gd", "")):
		if m.get_string(1) == "_anim":
			on_anim += 1
		else:
			off.append(m.get_string(0))
	_check("party_balloon.gd: every play() and seek() is on its own AnimationPlayer (%d)" % on_anim, off.is_empty() and on_anim == 2, off)
	var game: String = files.get("res://scripts/camp_balloons.gd", "")
	_check("camp_balloons.gd calls no play() or seek(), and has no AnimationPlayer",
		calls.search(game) == null and not game.contains("AnimationPlayer"), "")
	var users: Array = []
	for path: String in files:
		if files[path].contains("party_balloon") and path.get_file() not in ["camp_balloons.gd", "party_balloon.gd"]:
			users.append(path)
	_check("no other game script uses the balloon", users.is_empty(), users)


func _task() -> void:
	var tasks = camp.get("tasks")
	var real := _real()
	for i in 3:
		var b := real[i]
		var c: String = b.get("colour")
		await _under(b.global_position)
		var before := _pops.size()
		await _jump()
		var mine := _pops.slice(before)
		_check("%s: a jump under it (F held) pops it" % c, mine.size() == 1 and mine[0].balloon == b and b.get("popped") and not b.visible,
			"%d pops, popped %s, visible %s" % [mine.size(), b.get("popped"), b.visible])
		if mine.size() == 1:
			var jt: int = mine[0].jt
			_check("%s: popped within the bite, ticks 5-14 after F is seen (on tick %d)" % [c, jt], jt >= 5 and jt <= 14, jt)
			# The pop clip (Step 4): `pop` starts on the bite's tick, the balloon still showing;
			# it plays once through cells 3, 4, 5, and the balloon is hidden when it ends.
			var a: Dictionary = _after[b]
			_check("%s: on the bite's tick, `pop` starts and the balloon is still showing" % c,
				mine[0].clip == "pop" and mine[0].visible, "%s, visible %s" % [mine[0].clip, mine[0].visible])
			var cells: Array = a.cells.duplicate()
			cells.sort()
			_check("%s: `pop` plays once (started %d time(s)), showing cells %s" % [c, a.starts, cells],
				a.starts == 1 and cells == [3, 4, 5], "%d, %s" % [a.starts, cells])
			var after: int = a.hidden - a.pop_tick
			_check("%s: hidden once `pop` has played, %d ticks after the bite (its 6/24 s is 15)" % [c, after],
				after >= 15 and after <= 17, after)
			var wrong: Array = []
			for h: Array in mine[0].heard:
				if (h[1] <= HEAR) != h[2]:
					wrong.append("%s at %.2f m: heard %s" % h)
			_check("%s: heard by every camper within 8 m and no one further (%s)" % [c,
				", ".join(mine[0].heard.map(func(h: Array) -> String: return "%s %.1f m %s" % [h[0], h[1], "heard" if h[2] else "not"]))],
				wrong.is_empty(), wrong)
		for other in real:
			if not other.get("popped"):
				var a := other.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
				_check("%s still up: `float` playing" % other.get("colour"), a.current_animation == "float", a.current_animation)
		var want := i == 2
		_check("after %d popped: the task %s" % [i + 1, "ticked" if want else "not ticked yet"], tasks.is_done("balloons") == want,
			tasks.is_done("balloons"))
	var inside := 0
	var outside := 0
	for p: Dictionary in _pops:
		for h: Array in p.heard:
			if h[1] <= HEAR:
				inside += 1
			else:
				outside += 1
	_check("the hearing was tried both ways: campers within 8 m of a pop (%d) and further (%d)" % [inside, outside],
		inside > 0 and outside > 0, "%d, %d" % [inside, outside])


# --- The bite's edges, with balloons the test adds ----------------------------------

func _extra() -> Sprite3D:
	var b := BalloonScene.instantiate() as Sprite3D
	balloons_node.add_child(b)
	balloons_node.get("balloons").append(b)
	return b


func _edges() -> void:
	# At his mouth through the crouch: not popped on ticks 0-4, popped on tick 5.
	player.call("place", QUIET)
	await _wait(40)
	var e1 := _extra()
	e1.global_position = player.call("mouth_point")
	await _wait(20)
	_check("a balloon at his mouth as he stands: not popped (no jump, no bite)", not e1.get("popped"), e1.get("popped"))
	var in_crouch: Array = []
	var popped_on := -1
	_key(KEY_F, true)
	for i in 30:
		await ticked
		if _jt >= 0 and _jt <= 4:
			in_crouch.append([_jt, e1.global_position.distance_to(player.call("mouth_point")), e1.get("popped")])
		if popped_on < 0 and e1.get("popped"):
			popped_on = _jt
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt < 0, 120)
	_key(KEY_F, false)
	_check("in reach through the crouch, ticks 0-4, and not popped (%s)" % ", ".join(in_crouch.map(func(r: Array) -> String: return "%d: %.3f m" % [r[0], r[1]])),
		in_crouch.size() == 5 and in_crouch.all(func(r: Array) -> bool: return r[1] <= REACH and not r[2]), in_crouch)
	_check("then popped on tick 5, the bite's first", popped_on == 5, popped_on)
	await _wait(20)

	# Two at his mouth: one jump pops one.
	player.call("place", QUIET)
	await _wait(40)
	var side: Vector3 = player.global_basis.x * 0.08
	var e2 := _extra()
	var e3 := _extra()
	e2.global_position = player.call("mouth_point") + side
	e3.global_position = player.call("mouth_point") - side
	await _jump()
	var n := int(e2.get("popped")) + int(e3.get("popped"))
	_check("two balloons at his mouth: one jump pops one", n == 1, n)
	for e in [e2, e3]:
		if not e.get("popped"):
			e.global_position = Vector3(0, -100, 0)

	# In reach only as he comes down from a running jump (after tick 14): not popped.
	player.call("place", QUIET)
	await _wait(40)
	var e4 := _extra()
	e4.global_position = Vector3(0, -100, 0)
	_key(KEY_W, true)
	_key(KEY_SHIFT, true)
	await _wait(70)
	var ground := player.global_position.y
	_key(KEY_F, true)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt == 5, 20)
	# Taking off now: where he'll be as he lands, 25 ticks on (tests/jump_pins.gd), his mouth there.
	var v: Vector3 = player.velocity
	var land := player.global_position + Vector3(v.x, 0.0, v.z) * (25.0 / 60.0)
	var off: Vector3 = player.call("mouth_point") - player.global_position
	e4.global_position = Vector3(land.x, ground, land.z) + off
	var open_near := 0
	var closed_near: Array = []
	while _jt >= 0 or bool(player.get("model").get("jumping")):
		await ticked
		var d := e4.global_position.distance_to(player.call("mouth_point"))
		if player.call("bite_open") and d <= REACH:
			open_near += 1
		elif d <= REACH:
			closed_near.append(_jt)
		if _tick > 100000:
			break
	_key(KEY_F, false)
	_key(KEY_W, false)
	_key(KEY_SHIFT, false)
	_check("a running jump: the balloon out of reach on every tick of the bite", open_near == 0, open_near)
	_check("then in reach as he comes down and lands, after tick 14 (on %d ticks), and not popped" % closed_near.size(),
		closed_near.size() > 0 and not e4.get("popped"), "popped %s" % e4.get("popped"))

	player = Player.new()

	player.rotation.y = deg_to_rad(-122.0)

## Each log going on (strength up a step), as sampled the frame after: [strength, ratio].
var _steps: Array = []
var _prev_strength := -1.0


func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	# After the level's nodes, the driver among them, so what's read is what it set.
	process_priority = 100
	_camp = level.campsite
	_fire = _camp.campfire
	_driver = level.campfire_smoke
	_smoke = _driver.smoke
	_player = level.player
	_fire.lit.connect(func() -> void: _lit += 1)
	_fire.doused.connect(func() -> void: _doused += 1)
	# The state the copy entered the tree with, which its preprocess runs on.
	_check("#%d At load: emitting, amount_ratio, amount, strength" % (2 if mode == "load" else 1),
		"%s %.2f %d %.2f" % [mode == "load", 1.0 if mode == "load" else 0.0, AMOUNT, 1.0 if mode == "load" else 0.0],
		"%s %.2f %d %.2f" % [_smoke.emitting, _smoke.amount_ratio, _smoke.amount, _fire.strength])
	_run.call_deferred()


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if _smoke == null or not is_instance_valid(_smoke):
		return
	_frames += 1
	_max_gap = maxf(_max_gap, absf(_smoke.amount_ratio - _fire.strength))
	if _smoke.emitting != _fire.burning():
		_emit_wrong += 1
	if _smoke.amount != AMOUNT:
		_amount_wrong += 1
	if _prev_strength >= 0.0 and _fire.strength > _prev_strength + 0.1:
		_steps.append([snappedf(_fire.strength, 0.01), snappedf(_smoke.amount_ratio, 0.01)])
	_prev_strength = _fire.strength
	sampled.emit()


func _run() -> void:
	if mode == "load":
		await _run_load()
	else:
		await _run_cold()
	_whole_run()
	_finish()


## Burning at load: the column's state, and the feedback at 1.0 and below.
func _run_load() -> void:
	_check("#2 At load: preprocess on the copy (s)", "3.50", "%.2f" % _smoke.preprocess)
	await _wait(0.1)
	_check("#5 Burning at load: amount_ratio = strength = 1.00", "1.00 1.00",
		"%.2f %.2f" % [_smoke.amount_ratio, _fire.strength])
	await _wait(3.0)
	_check("#8 Burning down unfed: amount_ratio = strength, below 1", "true true",
		"%s %s" % [_follows(), _fire.strength < 1.0])


func _run_cold() -> void:
	# Out of everyone's way while the keeper builds it (as fire_test.gd).
	_player.place(Vector3(20.0, 0.02, 6.5))
	await _wait(0.2)
	_check("#3 Before it's lit: not emitting, amount_ratio 0", "false 0.00 0",
		"%s %.2f %d" % [_smoke.emitting, _smoke.amount_ratio, _lit])

	# 4. The keeper lights it on his own.
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _lit > 0, 40.0)
	await sampled
	_check("#4 Lit by the keeper: emitting, amount_ratio = strength = 0.30", "1 true 0.30 0.30",
		"%d %s %.2f %.2f" % [_lit, _smoke.emitting, _smoke.amount_ratio, _fire.strength])

	# 5. He builds it up, a log at a time, then goes back to his routine.
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _keeper_state() != CampPerson.State.TEND, 60.0)
	await sampled

120	
121	
122	## The open world's on (the dev menu, the checks): it burns down and is fed, and the
123	## circle, the firelight and the bucket work. `out` starts it cold.
124	func start_cycle(out := false) -> void:
125		cycle = true
126		open_world = true
127		if out:
128			strength = 0.0
129			dying = false
130	
131	
132	## Out, as the level loads when the tutorial's to run (main.gd): the author, 8 Nov 2026,
133	## "from the start of the tutorial the fire should be off".
134	func start_out() -> void:
135		strength = 0.0
136		dying = false
137	
138	
139	## The tutorial's pan starts (camp_tutorial.gd): the keeper sets about building it, and it
140	## burns down and is fed from now on; the open world's parts wait for `open`.
141	func start_building() -> void:
142		cycle = true
143	
144	
145	## The tutorial's done (camp_tutorial.gd): the circle, the firelight and the bucket work.
146	func open() -> void:
147		cycle = true
148		open_world = true
149	
150	
151	## True while it's burning at all.
152	func burning() -> bool:
153		return strength > 0.0
154	
155	
156	## True while the keeper should see to it: the bucket's over, or it wants a log.
157	func needs_tending() -> bool:
158		return cycle and not dying and not _dousing and (bucket_tipped or strength < FEED_BELOW)
159	
160	
161	## True while the keeper, at it already, should fetch another log.
162	func wants_more() -> bool:
163		return cycle and not dying and not _dousing and (bucket_tipped or strength < FEED_TO)
164	
165	
166	## A log on it (the keeper): from cold, it catches with a flare.
167	func add_log() -> void:
168		var was_out := strength <= 0.0
169		strength = minf(strength + LOG_ADDS, 1.0)
170		if was_out:
171			flare = 1.0
172			lit.emit()
173	
174	
175	## The keeper sets the bucket back up, full again.
176	func set_bucket_upright() -> void:
177		bucket_tipped = false
178		_bucket_mesh.transform = Transform3D.IDENTITY
179		_wet.visible = false
180	
181	
182	## True while he could tip the bucket over.
183	func can_tip() -> bool:
184		return open_world and cycle and not dying and not _dousing and not bucket_tipped and strength > 0.0
185	
186	
187	## Where the keeper stands to take a log, and to set the bucket up.
188	func woodpile_spot() -> Vector3:
189		var to_fire := (global_position - woodpile.global_position) * Vector3(1, 0, 1)
190		return woodpile.global_position + to_fire.normalized() * 0.75
191	
192	
193	func bucket_spot() -> Vector3:
194		var away := (bucket.global_position - global_position) * Vector3(1, 0, 1)
195		return bucket.global_position + away.normalized() * 0.6
196	
197	
198	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
199		flare = move_toward(flare, 0.0, delta / FLARE_TIME)
200		if _dousing:
201			strength = move_toward(strength, 0.0, delta / DOUSE_TIME)
202			_dousing = strength > 0.0
203		elif dying:
204			strength = move_toward(strength, 0.0, delta * DIE)
205			dying = strength > 0.0
206		elif cycle:
207			strength = move_toward(strength, 0.0, delta * BURN)
208		_glint.set_meta("found", not can_tip())
209		_watch()
210		var keeper = camp.keeper if camp else null
211		if keeper and keeper.state == CampPerson.State.WORK and needs_tending():
212			keeper.tend(self)
213	
214	
215	## True while the circle of sight is up: burning in the open world, the cones on.
216	func watching() -> bool:
217		return open_world and burning() and camp != null and camp.cones_on
218	
219	
220	## The circle of sight: as far as the firelight reaches; moving in it upright, he's spotted.
221	func _watch() -> void:
222		var on := watching()
223		eyes.blind = not on
224		eyes.show_on_ground(on)
225		if camp == null or camp._fire_light == null:
226			return
227		eyes.reach = maxf(camp._fire_light.omni_range * camp.FIRELIGHT, 0.1)
228		var red: bool = camp.clock < spotted_at + VisionCone.RED_TIME + VisionCone.FADE_OUT
229		eyes.set_look(1.0 if red else 0.0, 1.0)
230		var player = eyes.target
231		if not on or player == null or not eyes.seeing or player.sneaking:
232			return
233		if Vector2(player.velocity.x, player.velocity.z).length() < MOVING or camp.seen_within(SPOT_AGAIN):
234			return
235		var nearest = null
236		for person in camp.people:
237			if person.state in [CampPerson.State.WORK, CampPerson.State.RETURN, CampPerson.State.TEND,
238					CampPerson.State.PITCH, CampPerson.State.HANG, CampPerson.State.FIX] and (nearest == null
239					or person.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position)
240					< nearest.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position)):
241				nearest = person
242		spotted_at = camp.clock
243		camp.saw(player.global_position)
244		if nearest:
245			nearest.alert()
246	
247	
248	## Held E at the bucket (or a fixture, such as a preview): over it goes, toward the pit.
249	func douse() -> void:
250		bucket_tipped = true
251		_dousing = true
252		flare = 0.0
253		var toward := (-BUCKET).normalized()
254		var axis := Vector3(toward.x, 0, toward.y).cross(Vector3.DOWN).normalized()
255		_bucket_mesh.transform = Transform3D(Basis(axis, deg_to_rad(84.0)), Vector3(toward.x, 0, toward.y) * 0.14)
256		_wet.visible = true
257		camp.noise(global_position, HISS)
258		doused.emit()

extends Node3D
## The moths round the campfire (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, revision of 21 Nov 2026, "The extras' timings
## and places"; not graded): four, each a Sprite3D on bugs.png's cells 4 and 5, 0.1 m across,
## billboarded with nearest filtering, fluttering to `flutter` (animations/moth_flutter.tres) on
## its own AnimationPlayer. The author's words for them: "an indicator of the fire being on,
## and like surveillance being on."
## This is their driver, presentation only. It reads the fire (camp_fire.gd burning()) and
## writes nothing in the game. One writer to each animated node:
##   - each moth's Sprite3D `frame`: its own AnimationPlayer only;
##   - each AnimationPlayer: this script only, which plays `flutter` on it once, from its own
##     offset, so they don't flap in step;
##   - each pivot above a moth (its circle round the fire), and the root's `visible` (shown
##     while the fire burns, hidden while it doesn't): this script only.
## Built on 21 Nov 2026 by Claude Code.

## Each moth's circle: how far out from the fire's middle (m, 0.55-0.9), how high its middle
## (m, kept within 0.85-1.5 with its bob), how fast it goes round (rad/s; the sign is which
## way), where round it starts (rad), and where in the flutter it starts (s; the clip is 4/24 s).
const CIRCLES := [
	[0.55, 0.95, 2.2, 0.0, 0.0],
	[0.7, 1.25, -1.7, 1.6, 1.0 / 24.0],
	[0.8, 1.05, 1.4, 3.3, 2.0 / 24.0],
	[0.9, 1.4, -2.0, 4.8, 3.0 / 24.0],
]
## How far each bobs up and down as it circles (m), and how fast (rad/s).
const BOB := 0.05
const BOB_SPEED := 5.0

## Set before it's added (main.gd): the campfire it reads.
var fire: Node3D

var _pivots: Array[Node3D] = []
var _t := 0.0


func _ready() -> void:
	# Placed every frame in _process, so not interpolated between physics ticks.
	physics_interpolation_mode = Node.PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_OFF
	for i in CIRCLES.size():
		var pivot := get_node("Pivot%d" % i) as Node3D
		_pivots.append(pivot)
		var anim := pivot.get_node("Moth/AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
		anim.play("flutter")
		anim.seek(CIRCLES[i][4], true)
	_follow(0.0)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_follow(delta)


## Over the fire, shown while it burns, each moth on its circle.
func _follow(delta: float) -> void:
	if fire == null:
		visible = false
		return
	global_position = fire.global_position
	visible = fire.call("burning")
	_t += delta
	for i in _pivots.size():
		var c: Array = CIRCLES[i]
		var a: float = c[3] + c[2] * _t
		_pivots[i].position = Vector3(cos(a) * c[0], c[1] + BOB * sin(BOB_SPEED * _t + c[3]), sin(a) * c[0])

extends Node3D
## Builds the forest, the props, the raccoon and the to-do list. The game opens on the
## title screen (title_screen.gd), shown over this level: him curled up asleep in his
## hollow at night with the lullaby playing. New Game glides the camera in to the nap
## close-up, and play starts from there when a move key wakes him. Any `--` argument
## other than the title's own (`--title-...`) skips the title, for the debug flags below.
## Debug: `-- --screenshot=out.png [--closeup] [--pose=<state> [--left]]` saves a
## frame and quits; --pose shows the raccoon in one state: an animation of the rigged
## model (idle, walk, run, sneak, bored, sleep, climb), or with USE_SPRITES a
## cut-out (see raccoon_sprite.gd). `-- --sprites` uses the cut-outs for one run.
## `-- --sound-test` runs the automated sound check (scripts/sound_test.gd).
## Screenshot helpers: --grab-test, --climb-test, --rest-test (he naps in the hollow),
## --tick-test (the bin is knocked over), --jump-test (he jumps on frame 1, F held; he's
## at the top around frame 14), --shot-frame=N (default 45), and
## --see-collision (the raccoon half see-through, for use with --debug-collisions).
## `-- --bubble-demo` adds a yard of stand-ins for trying the thought bubbles

## Turns the keys that work while paused (Esc, M, N) into calls on the level.
class Keys extends Node:
	var level: Node

	func _ready() -> void:
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS

	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
		if not (event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo) or level.title:
			return
		match event.physical_keycode:
			KEY_ESCAPE:
				# The tutorial has the game paused already, until Tab.
				if not level.tutorial_running():
					level.toggle_pause()
			KEY_M:
				level.toggle_mute("Music")
			KEY_N:
				level.toggle_mute("SFX")


func _enter_tree() -> void:
	setup_buses()
	for action: String in INPUTS:
		if InputMap.has_action(action):
			continue
		InputMap.add_action(action)
		for key: Key in INPUTS[action]:
			var ev := InputEventKey.new()
			ev.physical_keycode = key
			InputMap.action_add_event(action, ev)
	var click := InputEventMouseButton.new()
	click.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
	InputMap.action_add_event("grab", click)
